name.zh: ms-swift 数据集/序列化 pickle RCE

description: ms-swift v4.6.0 packing cache (IndexedDataset data.idx/data-*.bin) and the rank/node Serializer.from_tensor channel unpickle attacker-controlled bytes with pickle.load/pickle.loads; whoever can write the dataset cache or inject the carried tensor gets code execution. Verified at function level against the verbatim pinned v4.6.0 upstream files.

params_schema.target: packing cache directory or tensor channel (read-only proof)
params_schema.snapshot: snapshot JSON path or dict (read-only modules)
params_schema.backup_targets: backup target list for the runner backup gate
